details:
Add an option in the main menu/avatar settings that allows users to restrict who can load and view their worn avatar based on a minimum Trust Rank threshold (e.g., setting an avatar to only be visible to Known or Trusted users).

More detailed explanation: VRChat allows users to control what they see based on other people's trust ranks, but we have no server-side or client-side control over who is allowed to download and see our avatar asset package (.vrca) in public or group public instances. A major issue creators face is "avatar ripping" via malicious client logging or ripper bots. These bots and malicious actors almost exclusively operate using throwaway accounts restricted to lower trust ranks (Visitor or New User). If users could set a minimum visibility threshold (for instance, hiding their avatar entirely from anyone below "User" or "Known" rank so that the .vrca does not download to those accounts), it would drastically mitigate public-world ripping risks without blocking legitimate friends and community members. For users below the threshold, the client could fallback to displaying a default robot. Since VRChat already tracks trust ranks globally and handles conditional asset loading based on trust levels, implementing this as an outbound creator safety option would be an incredible quality-of-life and security addition for everyone.
title: Avatar Visibility Restrictions Based on Minimum Trust Rank (Anti-Ripping Feature)
